key_insight: An oxygen pressure of 3.5 bar gave HVOF-sprayed Al65Cu20Fe15 coatings the best balance of wear resistance, structural integrity, and frictional stability.
engineering_relevance: Optimizing oxygen pressure can improve coating durability on AISI 321 stainless steel; the lowest friction alone did not indicate the best wear performance.
method: Deposited coatings at oxygen pressures of 3.0, 3.5, and 4.0 bar with other processing parameters fixed.
Examined microstructure and phase composition using microstructural analysis and X-ray diffraction.
Evaluated dry-sliding friction and wear, hardness, and adhesion strength.
evidence_signal: At 3.5 bar, the coating showed the highest quasi-crystalline phase fraction, maximum adhesion, and lowest wear rate with friction of 0.55–0.60; all coatings exceeded 750 HV.
watch_item: The optimum is supported only for the tested pressure settings and dry-sliding conditions; the abstract provides no numerical wear rates or uncertainty estimates.
paper_title: The effect of HVOF spraying parameters on the tribological properties of the Al 65 Cu 20 Fe 15 coatings
